method.visual: Opened both actual candidate PNGs with view_image and compared with previously physically inspected original sketches and prior versions.
method.pixelMeasurements: System.Drawing.Bitmap read-only per-pixel RGBA. Bounds measured independently at several alpha thresholds; seating faces measured as largest 4-connected cream region (A>240,R>165,G>150,B>100,R>B+12) within manually visually selected seating-face windows. Reported centres are region bounding-box midpoints, not prompt coordinates.
method.measurementUncertaintyPx: Approximately 1-2 px on seating-face centres due hand-drawn ellipse contours, antialiasing and highlights. Subpixel digits in least-squares fits are arithmetic, not claimed subpixel annotation accuracy.
method.coordinates: PNG measurements use top-left pixel coordinates. Standard BL converts y=1024-yTop. Battery authored controls use BL within the 627x627 top-left CELL, y=627-yTop; full-sheet BL adds another627. Bounds represented [x,y,width,height] top-origin unless explicitly stated.
method.scope: Only this report written. Native candidate images, metadata, code and Unity unchanged.

visualEvidence: Electric cyan trim and white-highlighted spherical gold studs of v9 become matte dark navy fittings and flatter muted brass with drawn texture.

Stone front/side faces now show strong directional blue hatch clusters, irregular chips and cracks; roof gains broken blue flecks and uneven marks. Material is substantially closer to original sketched blocks and current weapon/building parts.

The broad low tiled layout stays because mechanical footprint is retained; it still feels more regular than original masonry, but changed surface drawing unifies the family without forcing new wall geometry.
Foreground lower masonry edge extends visibly downward relative to v9; image is not an exact silhouette-preserving edit.

straightBands.status: Proposed conservative extension of existing authored straight bands, not a claim of uniquely visible horizontal boundary lines.
notes: Existing authored interior splits384 and511 can be retained for initial native metadata update; old lower base bound290 must expand downward to cover new physical stone.
Keepout's upper front boundary must still conservatively include the highest real corner side faces; do not reduce it merely to recover clearance.
New foreground depth must be included in silhouette, placement and sweep checks. Two-seat fit alone does not validate the whole object.

candidates.cropGuidance: alpha>1 native ink crop is [19,290,1499,474] top-origin, equivalent sheetBL [19,260,1499,474]. alpha>16 yields [21,291,1495,471], equivalent BL [21,262,1495,471]. Follow the existing pipeline cutoff/padding policy; raw alpha>0 includes scattered alpha1 pixels and is inappropriate as a physical crop.
candidates.recommendation: Adopt after root recalculates native crop and foreground extent with unchanged weapon envelope/seat logic and reruns required assembly validation. Reject a blind source-file swap with old crop.

visualEvidence: Previously sparse pale stone gains distinct diagonal blue hatch strokes, chipped edges, small blue scratch clusters and stronger navy side shadows.
Three-seat triangle, thin connected stone silhouette, quiet brass fasteners and same four-cell arrangement remain legible.
Still calmer than FullWeapon at source sheet scale, but glyph/stone distinction and contrast now match the family better. Judge at equal rendered part size because source-cell scales differ.
candidates.fitConclusion: A single uniform scale+translation preserves all three centres to max0.763px versus authored controls, below 1-2px annotation uncertainty; versus old measured faces max0.116px. Full rotated similarity residual0.338px adds no practically meaningful improvement and introduces unnecessary rotation.

straightBands.status: Conservative authored straight slices using existing old base/front fractions0.18/0.35 over a refreshed crop, not visually unique boundaries.
straightBands.note: If retaining authored absolute cuts instead of fractions, explicitly extend the old base lower bound to include new stone. The lower physical change is only approximately4px at alpha>16, versus Standard's approximately30px.

candidates.cropGuidance: Top-left cell alpha>1 crop[30,246,567,199] top-origin converts cellBL[30,182,567,199] and full-sheetBL[30,809,567,199]. alpha>16 crop[33,249,562,193] converts cellBL[33,185,562,193] or full-sheetBL[33,812,562,193]. Retain existing pipeline cutoff/padding convention; do not include remote alpha1 specks.
candidates.recommendation: Adopt after native crop metadata and single uniform source-to-world fit are refreshed; retain existing three logical mounts and no rotation if possible. Required runtime placement checks remain root-owned.

overallDecision: Both candidates improve source-style coherence. Seating layout passes measured similarity registration. Standard's foreground silhouette changed enough that runtime/collision validity is not established by this review. All exact transformation coefficients are measured-fit outputs; none are copied from generation prompts.
